items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Weaver, Sylvester Weaver heard me and had Mr. Rockwell come in here and that was my first record I ever made.

ctx.x: And you did little dates and things. And you talk about doing a session at the Palace Theatre?

Yeah, well that was a movie theatre, and they would have, you know, the band playing there. And it was there while I was playing at the Palace, that Mr. Weaver, Sylvester Weaver heard me and had Mr. Rockwell come in here and that was my first record I ever made.
How old were you at that time? Were you still at school?
